title: Naturally Garlicky Filipino Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Filipino dish featuring garlicky and juicy pork dumplings, perfect for a nostalgic meal, this recipe is low in glycemic index and cooked in a tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Preheat the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, chopped chives, minced garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
When the tajine is hot, add a small amount of oil to the bottom and swirl it around to coat the surface.
Add the dumplings to the tajine, leaving some space between each dumpling to allow for even cooking.
Cover the tajine with a lid and steam the dumplings over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the wrappers are tender.
